property_summary: For any address that successfully calls lockInGuess with 1 ether, the contract must record a non-zero lock block so that a subsequent settle() does not revert on the block == 0 guard; the mutant stores zero, so settle() always reverts on that guard and the test distinguishes the two by checking that the second call does not revert.
change_summary: Replace the block assignment in lockInGuess with a no-op self-assignment so the lock block number is never set.
